comparisons.name: notes-light
comparisons.description: The box around both notes, 373 by 282 pt, Aqua: the yellow note, key, with its title strip, widgets and text, over the blue note, whose top 22 pt and left 21 pt show. The two corners of the box that are desktop picture are masked: the demo has a stand-in for the picture. The text is set in a stand-in for Helvetica off Apple platforms, whose baseline lies half a point lower in the 14 pt line; the library's own comparison takes that half point off its example's padding, and the app, like any application, does not, which is what the 2x budget allows for.

comparisons.name: notes-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As notes-light with the text masked as well (the yellow note's lines and the insertion point under the last one, the starts of the blue note's lines and the top of its first line), to score the two notes, their place, the strip, the widgets and the shadow of the front note on the one behind.

comparisons.name: notes-dark
comparisons.description: The same box in the Dark Aqua capture, where Finder is frontmost: no note is key, so neither has a strip or widgets, and each has its 0.5 pt outline. The corners that are desktop picture are masked, and the text is set as in notes-light.

comparisons.name: notes-dark-drawing
comparisons.description: As notes-dark with the text masked as in notes-light-drawing, to score the two notes, their place, their outlines and the shadow of the front note on the one behind.

comparisons.name: menu-bar-light
comparisons.description: The left end of the menu bar while Stickies is frontmost, Aqua: the 22 pt strip, its shadow line, a stand-in for the mark of the Apple menu and the titles Stickies, File, Edit, Font, Color, Window and Help. The titles are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms, and the bar's material lies over a stand-in for the desktop picture.

comparisons.name: menu-bar-light-drawing
comparisons.description: As menu-bar-light with the mark and the titles masked, to score the strip and its shadow line alone. The mask runs from 20 pt to the crop's trailing edge at 400 pt, which cuts through Help: the title's first letters, in the fallback font, reach past 392 pt.
